summary: Phase phase-01 delivered all planned changes exactly as specified: five *-last command registrations and their run*Last handlers removed, resolveLastReviewOpenRun export deleted (confirmed by grep returning zero matches across src/ and tests/), stale sessionInfo.ts import dropped, cliProgram.test.ts TOP_LEVEL_COMMANDS updated, and all three derived artifacts regenerated via pnpm gen:usage-spec and pnpm docs:cli. The sole undocumented action — removal of the decodeRegistry import alongside resolveLastReviewOpenRun in the already-planned resolveRunInfo.ts — was mechanically necessary to pass pnpm knip and is explicitly disclosed in the handoff. Commit subject matches verbatim. No unjustified deviations.

findings.message: The decodeRegistry import was removed from src/app/resolveRunInfo.ts alongside resolveLastReviewOpenRun.
